fields.baseline: ENERGY STAR® qualified equipment for the listed equipment categories; demand controlled kitchen ventilation requires variable speed motors controlled to vary fan speed based on kitchen demand as indicated by connected sensors; anti-sweat heater controls must reduce anti-sweat heater energy consumption based on sensing humidity
fields.methodology: Prescriptive fixed incentive per qualifying unit based on equipment type/category meeting the listed minimum efficiency requirement; demand controlled kitchen ventilation exhaust hoods are paid at $0.15 per kWh of annual energy savings, and anti-sweat heater controls are paid per linear foot of case length.
fields.notes: Equipment that meets or exceeds the listed efficiency requirements may qualify for the listed incentive. Refer to Rocky Mountain Power's Wattsmart Homes program for residential appliances used in a business (Schedule 111). Demand controlled kitchen ventilation exhaust hood energy savings subject to approval by Rocky Mountain Power. Demand controlled kitchen ventilation and anti-sweat heater controls are retrofit only. Commercial dishwasher incentives apply to high temperature models with electric boosters only; ice machines air-cooled only. See Appliances section for additional incentives.
fields.rate: Commercial Dishwasher (high temperature models w/electric boosters only, ENERGY STAR qualified): under counter $100; single tank stationary (door type) $300; single tank conveyor $500; multiple tank conveyor $500. Electric Insulated Holding Cabinet (ENERGY STAR qualified): V ≥ 28 (double size) $1,000; 13 ≤ V < 28 (full size) $600; V < 13 (half size) $400. Electric Steam Cooker, all sizes: $600. Electric Convection Oven, full or half size: $350. Electric Fryer, width < 18 in (standard) or ≥ 18 in (large): $300. Electric Griddle, all sizes: $300. Electric Combination Oven, 3–40 pans: $700. Ice Machines (air-cooled only): harvest rate < 500 lbs/day $125; harvest rate ≥ 500 lbs/day $150. Demand Controlled Kitchen Ventilation Exhaust Hood (retrofit only): $0.15/kWh annual energy savings. Anti-Sweat Heater Controls (retrofit only): low-temp (freezing) cases $20/linear foot (case length); mid-temp (refrigerated) cases $16/linear foot (case length). Residential dishwasher, refrigerator and freezer used in a business: see offering in Schedule 111 (Wattsmart Homes program).
fields.tiers: Dishwasher: $100 / $300 / $500 / $500. Holding cabinet: $1,000 (V ≥ 28) / $600 (13 ≤ V < 28) / $400 (V < 13). Ice machines: $125 (<500 lbs/day) / $150 (≥500 lbs/day). Anti-sweat heater controls: $20/linear foot low-temp / $16/linear foot mid-temp.
fields.value: $100–$1,000 per qualifying unit; $0.15/kWh annual energy savings for demand controlled kitchen ventilation
